scenario: Validate creation of a tenant runner group
preconditions: Authorized CICD admin; tenant in registry
form_inputs: org, tenant, runner_group_name (TenantName_ prefix), visibility, approver, dry_run=true
expected_result: Status awaiting_approval; plan to create the group; no mutation

scenario: Creating an existing group is a no-op
expected_result: No-op; group already present, no duplicate

scenario: Reject a group name without the tenant prefix
expected_result: Rejected: group name must carry the tenant naming prefix
